Source header

Name
FIX_CHK
Purpose
Execute HELMR1 Remark : This script permits automatic verification of a given set of fiducial stations. In case of discrepancies, a modified FIX file can be output by HELMR1 and thus used to directly repeat the last ADDNEQ2 run, finally considering a reduced set of fiducial stations accepted for consistent datum definition.
Parameters
PARAM2 - goto PID for new datum definition (optionally) PARAM3 - STOP option for CRD (cross-)checking (optionally)
Author
M. Meindl, S. Schaer
Created
19-Oct-2003
Changes
07-Feb-2006/ss: Check whether PARAM2 defined 02-Sep-2010/ss/mm: Deactivated outlier rejection for second HELMR1 run 26-Sep-2012/ss: Further developed 27-Sep-2012/ss: STOP option implemented (activated with PARAM3) 28-Sep-2012/ss: Print LST filename in case of a stop 17-Apr-2013/hb: Exception for doy 13102 F1-F1C added 18-Apr-2013/cb: Exception for doy 13103 F3-F3C added 29-May-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13144 F3S and 13145 F1S added 30-May-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13146 F1S and 13145 F3S added 31-May-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13147 F1S and 13146 F3S added 01-Jun-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13148 F1S and 13147 F3S added 02-Jun-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13149 F1S and 13148 F3S added 03-Jun-2013/hb: Exceptions for doy 13150 F1S and 13149 F3S added 03-Jun-2013/ss: Most recent exceptions removed 04-Jun-2014/ss: Considered ULTyyddd.FLG 10-Sep-2014/ss: Increased tolerances in case of RAP 16-Dec-2014/ss/av: Updated for new HELMR1 (with ADDSTA/MAXREJ) 16-SEP-2015/rd: Relax HELMR1 check if singular elements are detected 19-Sep-2019/av: Use regex for IGSRAPID and IGSULTRA check 23-Feb-2024 SS: Corrective action automatically done if indicated

Notes
ESTIMATE LOCAL IONOSPHERE MAP (using V_K pole file) SHELL VARIABLES: YEAR : Year of the session to be processed (2 digit) SESSION : Session number (4 characters) CAMPAIGN: Campaign name CAMP_PTH: Campaign path CAMP_DRV: Drive letter for campain (i.e. P) OPT_DIR : Directory for panels PID : Process identification number (3 digits) SUB_PID : Subprocess id (3 digits) PRT_FILE: Protocol file name including path SCRIPT : Name of script TASKID : Task id of script, usually 00 PRIORITY: Priority of the script CPU : CPU the script is running on DAYYEAR : Julian day of the year DAY : Day of the Month MONTH : Month, 1=JAN, 12=DEC GPSWEEK : GPS week DAYWEEK : Day of the week, 0=SUN, 6=SAT V_X : X Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_O : O Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_Z : Z Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_PLUS : Plus variable in DAT151__.PAN V_MINUS : Minus variable in DAT151__.PAN V_x : User variable PARAMx : Script specific parameter, x is 1 thru 9 U : Directory path to U: Use the new menu

28-Sep-2016 ss: Adjust end times for 30-day solution (and 1605) 29-Sep-2016 ss: Update CODE OSB files 29-Sep-2016 ss: Verify solutions and check completeness of NEQs 30-Sep-2016 ss: Activated update of (ADDNEQ2-based) CODE.OSB 30-Sep-2016 ss: More detailed error messages 30-Sep-2016 ss: More detailed title lines 12-Oct-2016 ss: Send message in case of monthly solution update 13-Oct-2016 ss: Use @badSet in case of errors with monthly NEQs 17-Oct-2016 ss: Provide additional _STA last and rest solutions 21-Oct-2016 ss: Prepare case with bad FIN daily NEQs (16289) 28-Oct-2016 ss: Make use of OSBVAL option for LAST product 16-Nov-2016 ss: Distribute CODE BIA files 23-Nov-2016 ss: Changed $dirDis and bia2bia.com with -sat 24-Jan-2017 ss: Replaced %y: by %Y: 09-Jun-2017 ss: Consider REPRO_ION NQ0 results 14-Jun-2017 ss: Create extra satellite information file 29-Jun-2017 ss: Post CODE.BIA to ftp.aiub.unibe.ch/CODE 21-Jul-2017 ss: Added list of problematic daily solutions 25-Jul-2017 ss: Consider calibrated stations using STA_BIA.FIX 23-Aug-2017 ss: Corrected time window extension 06-Nov-2017 ss: Set $mjdL using $yyddd 06-Nov-2017 ss: Check on NaN entries 07-Feb-2018 SS: Use V_SAV (not V_DIS) for copyaftp 11-Apr-2018 ss: Make use of filter_code_bia.com 01-Sep-2018 av: uncompress not working (changed to gzip -d -f) 13-Sep-2019 SS: Check $HOST and skip procedure if indicated 14-Jul-2020 RD/PF: change $X/GEN -> PTH_SATELL 30-Jul-2020 ST: Add use igs_device. 07-Apr-2021 SS: Tolerance temporarily increased for CBG results now including BeiDou-3 (as of wk 2148) 20-May-2021 SS: Changed unused EXE_G95 paths 30-Mar-2022 AV: Modified SAT-CRX location MOdified SINEX input files 21-Feb-2024 SS: Making SAT_BIA_I20.SAT consistent to I14-based time series 17-Apr-2026 ss: Used temporary ADDNEQ2 version after bugfixing 22-Apr-2026 ss: Used regular ADDNEQ2 version (with bugfix)

Source header

Name
ULT_CHK
Purpose
Compare ultra-rapid precise orbit solution files with respect to most recent update(s) for acceptance control Instructions: How to react in an emergency case? 1. Find the cause of the problem why ULT_ERR.FLG was finally set. Some suggestions and ideas: a. grep posteriori $outf/RA_yy???.OUT (for long-arc issue) b. grep posteriori $outf/RQ_yy???.OUT (for AR issue) c. grep posteriori $outf/RH_yy???.OUT d. grep posteriori $outf/RG_yy???.OUT e. grep posteriori $outf/RF_yy???.OUT f. Study an affected ADDNEQ2 output in detail (especially in terms of maximum parameter improvement/correction). g. Alternatively, the cause could be a recently activated software or model change. 2. Fix the identified cause. 3. a. For unlocking, remove ULT_ERR.FLG by executing manually: mv $mscr/ULT_ERR.FLG $mscr/ULT_ERR.FLG_yyyyddmm b. Add a command line below (in this script) to temporarily increase $tol (in order to prevent another emergency stop). 4. Restart the IGSULTRA/IGSRAPID BPE (or repeat the affected processing steps). 5. Carefully check the latest analysis solutions. See also: $outr/ULT_CHK.LST Programs: ORBCMP
Author
S. Schaer
Created
14-Apr-2021
Changes
15-Apr-2021 SS: die instead of warn 16-Apr-2021 SS: Shifted forward echo command lines; considered ULT_CHK.FLG and STARTCOUNT; provided extra output 27-Apr-2021 SS: Excluded Galileo until further notice 29-Apr-2021 SS: Simplified (using loop) 20-May-2021 SS: Introduced emergency braking mechanism (ULT_ERR.FLG must be deleted manually) 20-May-2021 SS: Prepared IQR extraction 20-Jul-2021 SS: Considered #SUM information (with IQR); some extra checks for GPS, GLO, GAL 21-Jul-2021 SS: Checked IQR with and w/o Helmert parameters 20-May-2022 SS: Do no longer use $iqr_0 for checking 07-Sep-2023 SS: Unlocking after PENC accident (session 232490) 07-Sep-2023 SS: Instruction paragraph for unlocking drafted
